query: UPDATE event_outbox SET payload = jsonb_set(payload, '{name}', to_jsonb($2::text)) WHERE payload->>'name' <> '' AND payload->>'name' <> $2 AND ( (entity = 'contact' AND (entity_pid = $1 OR entity_pid IN (SELECT pid FROM contacts WHERE merged_into_pid = $1 /* deleted_at set or not: a merged duplicate is deleted */))) OR (entity = 'lead' AND entity_pid IN (SELECT pid FROM leads WHERE contact_pid = $1 /* deleted_at set or not: a deleted lead's events still name the person */)))
